selected_work_item: L3-DX9EX-001 / R32 fast-submit ACK cache complete game-run identity
summary: Scope the R32 fast-submit ACK identity, pending EVENT reuse, stale-completion discard and generation-fault suppression to the complete Frame.v2 identity (DirectGPU transport generation + game run generation + game PID) instead of transport generation alone.

C0_RECOVER.evidence: Recovered 00430 final state and post-1100 refactor terminal owner census. Structural chain remains complete, so the next independent DirectGPU lifetime/synchronization unit was selected.

C1_REVIEW.evidence: 00430 completed the shared ACK ABI identity, but R32 internal AckedFrame/AckedGeneration, ActiveAckGeneration and AckFaultGeneration state still keyed only on transport generation. A fast game restart or rare generation collision could therefore retain stale fast-submit cache/fault state across a different Frame.v2 game run.

C2_IMPLEMENT.evidence: af7dbe050e4d747fd639e853bfc826eea4a040d6 adds active/fault run-generation and game-PID identity, clears ACK caches when any identity component changes, rejects late pending completions from another run before publication, requires complete identity for same-frame EVENT reuse, and scopes generation-fault rejection to the same run.
